summary: Construction Partners, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 8, 2026, reporting an amendment to its existing credit agreement. The Sixth Amendment increases the revolving credit facility from $500 million to $700 million, adjusts financial covenants (minimum interest coverage ratio to 2.75x, maximum leverage ratio stepping down from 4.75x to 4.00x), and modifies negative covenants. This is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other corporate event is involved. The company simply upsized its credit line and relaxed certain financial terms to support ongoing operations. No deal terms or strategic changes are present.
